description: This file defines the ChaosAgentCommand class, a command-line command for orchestrating server chaos experiments by sending restart or shutdown messages to servers via a messaging channel, with configurable parameters such as service ID, cluster ID, wait times, and number of rounds.

classes.name: ChaosAgentCommand
classes.description: A command class for executing chaos testing operations like server restarts or shutdowns with customizable parameters.

methods.name: ChaosAgentCommand
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the command with options and a logger.

methods.name: RunAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous method executing the chaos test rounds by sending messages to servers.

methods.name: GetMessages
methods.description: Local method generating messages to be sent in each round, based on the parameters.
